title: Volley Assigned Agent Identity
description: Contents of .volley/agent.json in an agent's working directory. A supervisor writes it to pre-assign a literal agent id; a conforming MCP server that finds it uses agent_id verbatim (no random suffix). Not an envelope. See spec section 6.5.

agent_id.description: Literal agent id. Recommended form <wave>-<task>-<role>-<attempt>, lowercased.

task.description: A wave-file task id, or _release: the release train's pseudo task (spec section 4.6.19).

role.description: Pipeline role, e.g. implementer, spec_reviewer, quality_reviewer, fixup.

claude_account.description: The Claude account profile the supervisor launched the agent under (spec section 4.6.11); primary for the default profile.

issues.description: A bundle's issues (spec section 4.6.22): every issue the agent's one task, and its one PR, closes, the task's issue first. Absent for a task with one issue.

broker.description: Broker credentials for this agent (spec section 11.5). The supervisor mints them (volley auth add-agent) with username = agent_id. Beats VOLLEY_AUTH_USERNAME / VOLLEY_AUTH_PASSWORD.
